content.findings: The prior hashing limitation is resolved: prehash, consumed reads and closing manifest hashing use the capped reader. The growth fixture checks a single limit+1 read followed by rejection; metadata tests spy on the actual payload-read boundary. All seven added safeguards are present, including exporter consistency in bundle and native-plan validation.
limitations: Hash-bound declarations cannot authenticate reviewer truth
Global exclusion coverage, real semantic pairing/passports and actual owner admission remain external gates
Reported CPU tests were not rerun by this reviewer
Native qualification, baseline, candidate outcomes and reproducible gains remain unmeasured
content.observation_source: Direct collaboration agent final response; serialized by root
content.scope: Read-only bank/compiler/admission-test diff and protocol/runbook source. No imports, test execution, model calls, real payload reads, edits or approvals.

publication_policy: Portable historical evidence only, not an executable packet or admission/qualification permit. Local paths, chat UUIDs and XML hostnames are removed; original raw-file hashes are retained separately from hashes of these exports. No banks, predictions, weights, checkpoints, environments or raw process inventories are exported. Originals remain unchanged outside Git.
